_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 111 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: Defibrillator

description.text: This equipment can revive both squad members and teammates. Charge paddles for a short duration to revive a downed soldier with full health. Can also inflict damage on enemies.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
